verdict.rationale: Trivy's CLI clearly supports headless scanning (trivy fs, trivy k8s, docker run) and is described by users as 'easy to write automation around' and 'super easy to integrate in ci/cd pipeline', implying machine-readable output usable by an agent. However, the evidence never explicitly documents JSON/SARIF output flags or any built-in issue-filing/ticketing integration, so the 'parse results and file issues' half of the story is only inferred, not directly evidenced. missing for 10: explicit documentation of machine-readable output formats (JSON/SARIF), and any evidence of automated issue-filing or ticket-creation integration.
